an5.197:1.1: Pañc'ime bhikkhave vassassa antarāyā, yaṃ nemittā na jānanti, yattha nemittānaṃ cakkhu na kkhamati.
an5.197:1.5: Ayaṃ bhikkhave paṭhamo vassassa antarāyo, yaṃ nemittā na jānanti, yattha nemittānaṃ cakkhu na kkhamati. 3.
an5.197:2.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave upari ākāse vāyodhātu pakuppati,
an5.197:2.3: Ayaṃ bhikkhave dutiyo vassassa antarāyo, yaṃ nemittā na jānanti, yattha nemittānaṃ cakkhu na kkhamati. 4.
an5.197:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave Rāhu asurindo pāṇinā udakaṃ paṭicchitvā mahāsamudde chaḍḍeti.
an5.197:3.2: Ayaṃ bhikkhave tatiyo vassassa antarāyo, yaṃ nemittā na jānanti, yattha nemittānaṃ cakkhu na kkhamati. 5.
an5.197:4.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave vassavalāhakā devā pamattā honti.
an5.197:4.2: Ayaṃ bhikkhave catuttho vassassa antarāyo, yaṃ nemittā na jānanti, yattha nemittānaṃ cakkhu na kkhamati. 6.
an5.197:5.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave manussā adhammikā honti.
an5.197:5.2: Ayaṃ bhikkhave pañcamo vassassa antarāyo, yaṃ nemittā na jānanti, yattha nemittānaṃ cakkhu na kkhamati.
an5.197:5.3: Ime kho bhikkhave pañca vassassa antarāyā, yaṃ nemittā na jānanti, yattha nemittānaṃ cakkhu na kkhamatī
